<p class="pilot-note"><i class="bi bi-info-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i> Assigned tasks · supervisor review required</p>

<details class="guide-section" open><summary>Overview</summary>

Your supervisor assigns you a task with an OpenNeuro dataset, a subject, a Colab notebook, and expected outputs. For assigned analysis tasks, you do not need to install Git or Quarto. You need a browser, the Google account invited to the output folder, and the GitHub account used for your task.

</details>

<details class="guide-section" id="1-open-your-assigned-task"><summary>1 · Open your assigned task</summary>

[View tasks assigned to me](https://github.com/Donggyurim/neuroimaging-training/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+assignee%3A%40me){.action-link .primary-action}

Check the task for its dataset accession and snapshot, assigned subject ID, Colab notebook, task ID, expected files, and due date. Ask your supervisor if any of these are missing; do not choose a different subject yourself.

The training repository and its GitHub task issues are public. Keep personal information and private Drive links out of task descriptions and comments. Your supervisor shares the output folder with you separately through Google Drive.

**Done when:** you can open the assigned task and identify the exact dataset, subject, notebook, and expected output.

</details>

<details class="guide-section" id="2-connect-the-shared-drive-folder"><summary>2 · Connect the shared output folder</summary>

Sign in to the Google account your supervisor invited. In Drive, open **Shared with me**, right-click the output folder, then choose **Organize → Add shortcut** and place it in **My Drive**. Remember the shortcut's exact folder name; the notebook asks for it.

For a cohort, the supervisor should share a separate folder with each student. Everyone with access to the same shared folder can see its contents.

**Done when:** you can open the folder from **My Drive** and can add a small test file.

</details>

<details class="guide-section" id="3-open-colab"><summary>3 · Open the assigned notebook</summary>

Open the Colab link in your task. In Colab, choose **File → Save a copy in Drive** and use the Google account that has access to the shared folder. When the notebook asks to connect Drive, review the request and approve it for this course notebook.

At the top of the notebook, enter the task ID, assigned subject ID, and exact shared-folder name from your task and Drive. The first pilot notebook is configured for **ds004144**; its dataset snapshot and integrity checks are fixed.

**Done when:** the notebook confirms the assigned task and shows a results path inside the shared folder.

</details>

<details class="guide-section" id="4-run-the-assigned-scan"><summary>4 · Run the assigned scan</summary>

Run the notebook cells in order. Stop at the first error and report the task ID, cell heading, and error to your supervisor. Do not substitute another subject or disable a checksum check.

The scan is processed in Colab's temporary workspace. The notebook writes the segmentation, CSV, logs, provenance, quality-control images, and handover into your supervisor-shared folder. Colab can disconnect, so wait for each output to be saved before ending the session.

**Done when:** the notebook finishes and records a QC status and notes.

</details>

<details class="guide-section" id="5-submit-your-handover"><summary>5 · Submit your handover</summary>

Open the shared folder and confirm the run folder contains the expected files. Add a comment to your assigned GitHub task with the run ID, QC status, and any blocker. Do not paste the private Drive link into the public issue; your supervisor already has access to the shared folder.

Your supervisor reviews the files and makes a supervisor-owned copy of accepted outputs for retention.

**Done when:** your supervisor can identify the run and review its outputs.

</details>

<details class="guide-section" id="when-something-goes-wrong"><summary>Troubleshooting</summary>

::: {.table-responsive tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Troubleshooting table"}

| What you see | What to try |
|---|---|
| The assigned task is missing | Check that you are signed into the GitHub account your supervisor assigned. Contact the supervisor if it is still missing. |
| The shared folder is missing in Colab | Check the Google account, add the shared folder as a shortcut in My Drive, and enter its exact name. |
| Colab cannot connect to Drive | Confirm you are signed into the invited Google account, then rerun the Drive connection cell. |
| The subject has no matching scan | Stop and report the task ID and subject ID. Do not substitute another scan. |
| A download or checksum check fails | Stop and report the exact cell. Do not bypass the check. |
| GPU is unavailable | Try another session later or use CPU; processing will be slower. |
| Segmentation fails | Read the saved log if present, report the error, and do not interpret partial outputs. |

:::

</details>
